android.desc:
Terminal, Shell for AndroidTerminal, Shell,Command Line for android has features :

+) Typing command line,shell bash, Terminal for android devices
+ Full Linux terminal emulation.
+ Support UTF-8 text encoding. (Arabic, Chinese, Greek, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Thai, etc.)
+) Support root commandline
+) Multi screen for typing command line
+) Custom font typing (font size, font color)
+) Linux command,linux shell, linux terminal for android devices
+) 100% Free

Thankyou for using application.
